description: This file contains the implementation of the GrainDirectoryPartition class in the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace, including methods for registering, looking up, and deregistering grain addresses, along with internal helper methods and logging.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Internal sealed partial class responsible for managing grain address registration, lookup, and deregistration within the grain directory partition.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain address if the current view owner permits, ensuring membership version consistency.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID, verifying ownership and membership version.

methods.name: DeregisterAsync
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address if ownership criteria are met, updating the directory accordingly.

methods.name: DeregisterCore
methods.description: Internal method to remove a grain address from the directory, considering whether the silo is dead.

methods.name: LookupCore
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve a grain address from the directory if the silo is alive.

methods.name: RegisterCore
methods.description: Internal method to register or update a grain address in the directory with membership version alignment.

methods.name: IsSiloDead
methods.description: Checks whether the silo hosting a specific grain address is marked as dead.
